items.title: Cassius Wilson Interview, 1962-04-05
items.q: Punch is strong now. He's coming back, Punch.

ctx.x: Huh? Yeah, well he was shocked.
That's what happened with a lot of them fellows. They just drink, drink. I don't know. Punch is strong now. He's coming back, Punch. Yeah, yeah, yeah.
I'm telling you he's coming back. I'm glad to see him well because I thought he was going to leave us for a while.
